scores.notes: Compared the bowler-hatted man with the doctor's bag in the left street scene and the one Holmes is pulling into the room on the right. Both have brown hair, a dark moustache and the same apparent age and build. The right face is slightly fuller.

Compared the seated bowler-hatted man in the left railway carriage with the bowler-hatted man held by Holmes on the right. Both scenes are in daylight. The left man has sandy, light-brown hair and no visible moustache. The right man has dark hair, a thick dark moustache and a broader face.
Compared the seated man in the armchair on the left with the man holding a match and cane in the bedroom on the right. Both have dark curly hair, a long clean-shaven face and a lean build.
Compared the man standing behind Holmes in the left room with the seated man in the right carriage. Both have light-brown swept hair, a brown moustache, a similar face and a similar middle age.

The left shows a whitewashed house burning among trees, hedgerows and open fields. The right, from the train, shows only a smoke and fire column over a clump of trees in flat farmland. The land and vegetation are compatible. The left is deep night and the right is twilight, but lamps and lanterns are lit in both.

The left shows a whitewashed house burning among bare trees in open, hedged farmland under a dusk-blue sky. The right shows a smoke column rising from a tree clump in flat green farmland under a similar dusk sky. The land, trees and time of day are compatible, though the house itself is hidden on the right.
Compared the seated man in the left carriage with the bowler-hatted man holding the bag in the right street. Both have light-brown hair, a brown moustache, the same face shape and the same age.
Compared the man throwing papers on the left with the man holding the lens and pipe in the right street. Both have dark curly hair, a long clean-shaven face and a tall lean build.

Compared the bowler-hatted man being pulled into the left room with the seated man in the right carriage. Both have a brown moustache and brown hair, which is slightly darker on the left, and a similar face, age and build.

Both are night scenes. The left shows a fire and smoke column rising from a clump of trees beyond flat, dark farmland. The right shows a white house burning among bare trees, hedges and fields. The rural layout and time of day are compatible.
Compared the man holding the revolver in the left bedroom with the bowler-hatted man held by Holmes on the right. Both have brown hair, a brown moustache, the same face shape and the same age.
Compared the man pulling Watson through the door on the left with the man seated in the armchair on the right. Both have dark curly hair, a long clean-shaven face and a lean build.

Compared the man standing behind Holmes in the left room with the man holding the revolver in the dim right bedroom. Face shape, age and build match. The right man's hair looks lighter, which may be the warm match light, and his moustache is hard to make out in the gloom.
Compared the man holding the match and cane in the left bedroom with the man at the door on the right. Both have dark curly hair and a long clean-shaven face.
Compared the man examining the hat on the left with the man seated in the armchair on the right. Both have dark curly hair and a long clean-shaven face, and they appear to be the same age.
Compared the man seated in the armchair on the left with the man at the door on the right. Both have dark wavy hair and a long clean-shaven face.

Both show a whitewashed two-storey house with end chimneys burning at night. Each has bare trees, hedges and a wooden gate onto a track, and the right also shows fire engines in the front garden.
Both show a brick barrel-vaulted cellar with stone-flag floors and wooden crates and boxes. The lighting differs as the descriptions require, with the lantern dark on the left and lit on the right.

Holmes with the match by the bed (left) and Holmes with the lens and hat at the desk (right) both have dark curly hair, a clean-shaven long narrow face and a lean build.
Holmes in the bedroom (left) and Holmes throwing papers in the railway carriage (right) both have dark tousled hair, a clean-shaven narrow face and a lean build.

Both show a whitewashed two-storey house with tall chimneys burning at night, with hedgerows, a gate, bare trees and fire-engines in front. The left sky is a dusk blue and the right is darker, but the house and grounds match.
In both watercolours Holmes, examining the hat (left) and kneeling on the bed with the cane (right), has dark curly hair, a clean-shaven long face and the same angular features.

Both show a brick-arched vault with stone-flagged floors and stacked wooden crates and boxes. The left is a long arched corridor and the right is a nearer arch with crates in front, which fits the same cellar.
